topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out about the job thing today. It wasn’t a surprise, not really. We all have our reasons, I guess. I took a moment to think about it, what this means for us. I decided to talk to them, face to face. No point in making a big scene or anything. Just need to understand why, where this comes from. Friendships are built on trust, but they also need understanding and patience. I’ll listen, and then we’ll go from there.
